title: Origami
description: A sheet of heavy washi printed with a 1909 baseball card lies on dark felt. Drag any edge or corner across it to fold it along a crease that follows your hand; double-click and it opens flat, keeping every crease.
intent: One paper mechanic finished to the edge: a real rigid fold around a soft bend that presses into a crisp crease, layers that stack with their own thickness, and a sheet that remembers every fold it has been through.
